title: What is Redux Toolkit?
overview: Redux Toolkit is the official recommended way to write Redux logic. It simplifies store setup, reducers, actions, and state management.

example.title: Redux vs Redux Toolkit
example.content:
Traditional Redux:
More boilerplate code

Redux Toolkit:
Less code
Built-in utilities

title: Why Use Redux Toolkit?
overview: Redux Toolkit reduces complexity by providing built-in functions for common Redux tasks.

example.title: Benefits
example.content:
✔ Less boilerplate
✔ Easier configuration
✔ Built-in Immer support
✔ Better developer experience

title: configureStore
overview: configureStore creates the Redux store with default middleware and DevTools support.

example.title: configureStore Example

title: createSlice
overview: createSlice combines reducers and action creators into a single structure, reducing Redux boilerplate.

example.title: createSlice Example

title: Immer in Redux Toolkit
overview: Redux Toolkit uses Immer internally, allowing developers to write simpler update logic while keeping state immutable.

title: Redux Toolkit Folder Structure
overview: A proper Redux Toolkit structure separates store configuration, slices, and application logic.

title: Redux Toolkit with React
overview: Redux Toolkit works with React using React Redux hooks like useSelector and useDispatch.

example.title: Usage Flow
example.content:
Component
 ↓
useDispatch()
 ↓
Slice Reducer
 ↓
Store
 ↓
useSelector()
